2026_04_JAX_CIN.headline: Jacksonville’s takeaway-minded defense faces Cincinnati’s resurgent passing attack on the road
2026_04_JAX_CIN.paragraph1: Jacksonville rebounded in Week 3 with three sacks and three takeaways while holding New England to six points, but its road form has been less convincing. Cincinnati returns home after an offensive performance that stressed Pittsburgh’s defense and now gets another aggressive front to solve. The Jaguars need pressure to arrive without opening easy throws, while the Bengals must protect Joe Burrow and avoid giving Jacksonville short fields. If Cincinnati keeps the pocket clean, Jacksonville’s defense faces a much harder assignment than last week.
2026_04_JAX_CIN.model_rationale: Jacksonville’s disruptive defense can swing possessions, but Cincinnati’s protection and passing efficiency are positioned to test whether those takeaways travel against a stronger offense.
